correctness.rationale: For iid Gaussian fold means, direct algebra gives the LOFO errors as scaled S-Z_i. Their exact covariance matrix has diagonal B-1 and off-diagonal B-2, so a one-factor Gaussian representation yields the displayed orthant integral. Orthogonal decomposition of the Gaussian vector into its mean and centered residual subspace yields an exact residual-extreme representation of coverage; Taylor expansion plus standard Gaussian maximum estimates proves the sharp asymptotic. The range identity proves the width formula samplewise. Numerical anchors are independently replayed by the embedded verifier.

value.rationale: Overlapping leave-one-fold-out reuse is a natural efficiency modification of sample splitting. The theorem shows a severe and counterintuitive calibration failure: every interval is B-1 times narrower than the disjoint-fold hull, yet coverage tends to zero at an explicit rate. This gives a useful structural warning about dependence in convex-hull inference rather than a routine recomputation.
